messages:
deploy-bot: STARTED deploy wave -> env: prod 
deploy-bot: tag=release-2026-03-12, commit=abcdef12345
deploy-bot: services: runtime@v2.3.1, api@v1.9.0, console@v0.22.0
deploy-bot: rollout plan: wave-1 (runtime+api) 10% canary -> 100% auto, wave-2 (console) hold until api at 100%
deploy-bot: CI: all checks green. run: https://ci.internal/redwood/releases/1859004321

emma: ACK — watching runtime canary metrics. we shipped a hotfix for the memory leak, suggest pinning runtime to v2.3.1-hotfix for this wave.
raj: runtime pinned to v2.3.1-hotfix in deploy config (confirmed). traffic-split set to 10% -> 100% after 10m if no errors. attaching traces.
morgan: note — console depends on new auth header behavior from api v1.9.0. prefer to keep console queued until api at 100%.
lina: +1 hold console until api stable.
deploy-bot: UPDATE runtime canary deployed to 10% (hosts: 6). api canary deployed to 10% (hosts: 4). console: queued.
emma: seeing one 502 from runtime-canary i-09f, sample log:
```
ERROR runtime handler: panic: runtime: out of memory
stack: ...
127.0.0.1 - - [12/Mar/2026] "POST /v1/complete" 502 12ms
```
raj: looks like OOM on that node, probably old instance type. giving it 2m to auto-drain, if it persists we should mark unhealthy and remove from pool.
deploy-bot: ALERT runtime canary instance i-09f marked unhealthy, draining -> runtime canary now ~8% traffic (after immediate drain).
sasha: creating a quick page if error rate spikes > 1% in last 5m, but current error burst contained. monitoring dashboards updated.
morgan: holding console deploy until runtime fully healthy and api at 100%.
emma: after drain metrics look stable; latency +0.2ms, error-rate returned to baseline. green to continue to 100%? :white_check_mark:
raj: rolling to 100% now for runtime and api. rolling ETA ~5m. will post progress.
deploy-bot: UPDATE rolling -> runtime 50% (progressing), api 100% (completed).
raj: runtime rollout finished: 100% on v2.3.1-hotfix. summary: brief canary OOM on one machine prevented a wider regression thanks to auto-drain.
deploy-bot: UPDATE complete for wave-1: runtime=100% api=100% console=queued. release tag: release-2026-03-12@abcdef12345. changelog: https://internal.redwood/changelog/2026-03-12
morgan: console deploy starting now. no DB migrations required. doing parallel rollout to all console nodes.
deploy-bot: console deployed to 100% on v0.22.0. all services now aligned to tag release-2026-03-12.
emma: quick smoke looks good from apps and webhooks.
sasha: monitoring post-deploy 30m window. will escalate if SLOs degrade.
deploy-bot: FINISHED deploy wave -> env=prod, tag=release-2026-03-12, commit=abcdef12345 :white_check_mark:
morgan: adding release notes and user-visible changes to the release doc.
lina: adding a short note about the runtime hotfix and that we pinned runtime for this wave.
emma: thanks team. closing thread.
